confidence_notes: Restaurant food anchors rest on aggregator travel-guide ranges and a few local rupee price mentions, so they are rough. Beer and cocktail anchors are inferred from Kerala off-premise retail beer prices, with bar markup assumed, not from bar menus. Wine is an inferred relationship to beer and cocktail prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Munnar's hill-station context; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were inspected. The FX observation may not be the latest available on 2026-11-19: the latest RBA value I could retrieve was dated 2026-03-20, and I did not use an unverified third-party July 2026 figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct price index for Munnar was found. Basis is Kerala hill-station and tourist-town pricing in India, with restaurant prices informed by Kerala local eateries and tourist-oriented venues, beer and cocktail prices inferred from Kerala retail beer prices, and accommodation estimated from general Indian hill-station tourism levels.
